Package frc.robot.subsystems.photon

Class CameraReplay

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.photon.CameraIO
frc.robot.subsystems.photon.CameraReplay
public class CameraReplay extends CameraIO
Replay implementation of CameraIO for simulation/log replay.

This class is used when replaying recorded robot data from AdvantageKit logs. It does not interact with any real hardware or simulation - all QuestNav data is read directly from the logged CameraIO.CameraData values.

All methods are no-ops because all replayed data is immutable.
